name: Mall Trash Bin
summary: A walnut-slatted jade waste bin with a real open aperture, inset liner and champagne-brass rim.
description: A walnut-slatted jade waste bin with a real open aperture, inset liner and champagne-brass rim.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials. Blender bundled Bfont labels are converted to mesh in the GLB. No external textures or models.
